title: Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways manage tool catalogs for language model agents using two primary paradigms: code mode where agents write scripts against tool stubs and decision layers which are cheap routers that preselect tool subsets. Using a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools, and three open-weight agents including Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, we present a preregistered evaluation on a sealed test split to determine when each approach succeeds. Code mode substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70 to 90 percent while significantly boosting utility. Declaring return-shape hints in code mode stubs is a first-order variable, swinging success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, an effect larger than adding a router. translated_title: 超越朴素MCP：决策模型与代码模式能让工具调用更便宜、更快速吗？
translated_abstract: 模型上下文协议（MCP）网关为语言模型智能体管理工具目录，主要采用两种范式：代码模式——智能体针对工具存根编写脚本，以及决策层——预选工具子集的低成本路由器。我们使用受控测试框架，覆盖12个服务器、多达1,958个干扰工具，以及包括Qwen、Gemma和Nemotron在内的三个开源权重智能体，在密封的测试集上开展了一项预注册评估，以确定每种方法何时能够奏效。结果表明，代码模式显著优于朴素MCP，可将token使用量削减70%至90%，同时大幅提升任务效用。在代码模式存根中声明返回形状提示是一个一阶变量，可使表现较弱的智能体的成功率波动高达39.5个百分点，其影响甚至大于添加路由器。而核心假设——在代码模式之前部署决策层会优于单独使用代码模式——并未得到证实，仅显示出微小且在统计上不显著的改进。
tldr: 该研究通过预注册控制实验证明，让智能体直接针对工具存根编写脚本的“代码模式”可大幅削减70%-90%的token消耗并显著提升任务效用，其中在存根中声明返回形状提示是关键因素，而在其前叠加决策层路由器并未带来显著额外收益。
en_tdlr: Through a preregistered controlled evaluation, this study shows that code mode—where agents write scripts against tool stubs—cuts token usage by 70–90% while significantly boosting utility, with return-shape hints in stubs being a first-order factor, whereas adding a decision-layer router yields no statistically significant additional gains.
